tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of major previous IT / ITES outsourcing contracts executed during the last fifteen years and details of providing such manpower to the Central Government or State Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work orders/contract agreements and completion or satisfactory performance certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in providing IT / ITES outsourcing contracts executed during any of the last fifteen years and details of providing such manpower to the Central Government or State Government, Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India

Size of the Firm (No. of IT Professionals and details of the professionals shall be submitted along with proof of current working status). The bidder shall have a minimum of 200 technically qualified employees on its payroll as on the last date of submission of the bid.Technically qualified employees" means personnel engaged in IT/ITES, software development, data centre / infrastructure management, networking, database administration, GIS, cybersecurity, DevOps, application support or allied technical services, and excludes purely administrative, HR, finance, housekeeping and non-technical personnel.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A certificate from the authorised signatory of the company supported by the latest EPF or ECR return or equivalent statutory records

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have experience in Data Centre Management, IT Infrastructure Management, Software Application Development / Maintenance, GIS Application Development / Maintenance, Database Administration, Network Administration, DevOps or IT / ITES Managed Services in / within Central Government or State Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work orders and satisfactory certificates.
